_comment: ONE source of truth for what motion this engine can perform. mocap_retarget.py reads it for its action->clip candidates and bake.py derives the per-character clip set from it, because the two used to name the same BVH files in two independent tables and nothing kept them honest. Adding an action is a data edit here plus the .bvh next door -- see ATTRIBUTION.md for the licence (CMU motion is commercial-safe to retarget and ship, and NOT to resell as data).

fight.note: strike slice of the fight clip -- the swing, not the wind-down
